papers.title: On Identifiability in Transformers
papers.authors: Gino Brunner; Yang Liu; Damian Pascual; Oliver Richter; Massimiliano Ciaramita; Roger Wattenhofer
papers.finding: Section3 treats free per-input attention, value-output nullspaces and simplex constraints, equation7; this does not certify reachability under one shared relation effect.
papers.limit: Only pages1-4 read. Appendices and experiments not used; no refutation of their scoped theorem.

papers.title: Quantum Tomography under Prior Information
papers.authors: Teiko Heinosaari; Luca Mazzarella; Michael M. Wolf
papers.finding: Section2 proposition2 states restricted informational completeness as state-difference intersection with observational orthogonal complement; the primary ratio-linearized shared-effect criterion is an application of this known framework.
papers.limit: Only pages1-5 read. No optimal sample count or stability claim imported from later sections; pure/circuit reachability is narrower than mixed-effect relaxation.
